# Invented 2027 Give Lively export

`givelively-export.csv` is Natalie Walker's invented export (Oct 17, 2026), shaped like AAFE's own: 28 purchases on the gala page,
its Community Tickets page and another campaign's raffle page, with guest lists typed the way buyers type them. Everything in it is
invented: emails on reserved example domains, phone numbers in the fictional 555-0100 to 555-0199 range, "Example Street" addresses.
One organization was renamed from Natalie's original because its name nearly matched a real credit union (as PR #62 did for the
door list).

Used by `prototype/scripts/test-givelively-2027.mjs` and `prototype/staff-app/src/import.test.ts` (Gate 1, #146).
